overall_summary: Data volume is very low overall, but videos focusing on 'self respect' with micro-digital interaction hooks (like chats, pinned messages, typing status) slightly outperform other topics, showing up to 41 views compared to single-digit views on abstract night/lonely thoughts.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos referencing phone UI elements like deleting chats (AfaLxMy6FMY - 41 views), status lists (rwOUYo_hayQ - 41 views), and read receipts (wFimeeP_aVc - 35 views) perform better than abstract poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on specific, tactile smartphone interaction moments related to letting go.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract night/lonely themes without a concrete anchor
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के ख्याल और अधूरा इंतजार' (uIbMpCjVutQ) got only 5 views and 'ओवरथिंकिंग और अधूरी उम्मीद' (WhJ-VwRa3Rg) got 7 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid vague or purely poetic late-night descriptions; always ground the emotion in a physical, everyday object or digital action.

next_video.concept: Turning off read receipts for that one specific contact so their name never shows 'seen' again, reclaiming personal peace.
